A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 34-page versions of UNIGEN with matching sections and Appendices A–I. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of their equations, tables, figures and appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset-generation experiments, module evaluations, human assessments, LLM benchmarking and data-augmentation results in Section 4, with additional experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the main experiments and Appendix E's temperature, user-constraint and additional benchmarking evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical generation, attribute guidance, self-reflection, code-based verification, RAG validation, difficulty enhancement and group-checking procedures. The appendix prompt templates and fine-tuning procedure are also unchanged.

E1.justification: The four generation benchmarks, ten augmentation tasks and Appendix E constraint scenarios remain identical. Correcting the appendix citations from CMMLU to MMLU changes attribution, not the datasets or languages actually evaluated.

E2.justification: DyVal2 principles 1–4 remain the evaluated knowledge-richness comparators in Table 3. Comparator membership in the benchmarking and data-augmentation experiments is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendices C, D and I retain the same five-person human evaluation, sample counts, temperature-0 inference, 200-sample fine-tuning, training settings and LLM-as-a-Judge procedures. No evaluation metric, split or model configuration changes.

E4.justification: The module evaluations, difficulty tests, error and cost analyses, temperature sensitivity, semantic-embedding analysis and user-constraint tests are identical. Appendix examples and training curves are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including averaging the five students' performance in Appendix C. v3 introduces no additional run or seed disclosures, uncertainty estimates or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including the appendix results. For example, Table 3 retains UNIGEN's 3.83% average entity overlap, and Table 4 retains the 4.2% RAG correction percentage.

T1.justification: The dataset-generation formulation, attribute-conditioned generation definition, Euclidean-distance filtering rule and Appendix D supervised fine-tuning objective are identical. No mathematical definitions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about generality, diversity, accuracy, controllability, dynamic benchmarking and data augmentation.

C2.justification: Interpretations of benchmark difficulty, knowledge richness and limited augmentation gains on knowledge-intensive tasks remain unchanged. Appendix A's limitations and Appendix F's societal concerns are also unchanged apart from citations.

D1.justification: The annotation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware, prompt templates and evaluation details in Appendices C, D, H and I are identical. Website, toolkit and other technical resource links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds Quantifying AI Psychology as v3 reference [86]. The incorrectly cited CMMLU work is removed, and MMLU mentions in Appendices A/B point to existing reference [73]. The alignment survey is retained under a new number; the main research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 replaces the NeurIPS 2024 footer with 'Preprint. Under review.', updates several bibliographic entries and changes 'finetuning' to the typo 'fineu’runing' in Section 2. The narrative and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The title-page footer and version annotation change, while bibliography spacing and page breaks reflow. All figures and tables retain their content, design and placement.

improvement.justification: The corrected MMLU citations and updated bibliography provide small attribution improvements, alongside an introduced Section 2 typo. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so these localized edits do not produce a meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
